final: WITH visit_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), total AS (SELECT SUM(visit_count) AS total_visits FROM visit_counts), shares AS (SELECT ID, visit_count, 1.0 * visit_count / total_visits AS share FROM visit_counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE total_visits IS NOT NULL), average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT ID, visit_count, share, share - average_share AS difference FROM shares CROSS JOIN average WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
